definitions.explanation: The person or team that wins a competition, tournament, or championship. The person who takes first place.

examples.japanese: {優勝者|ゆうしょうしゃ}にトロフィーが{贈|おく}られた。
examples.english: A trophy was presented to the champion.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{優勝者|ゆうしょうしゃ}は{誰|だれ}ですか。
{大会|たいかい}の{優勝者|ゆうしょうしゃ}には{賞金|しょうきん}{百万円|ひゃくまんえん}と{海外|かいがい}{遠征|えんせい}の{権利|けんり}が{与|あた}えられる。
examples.english: The tournament champion is awarded one million yen in prize money and the right to compete overseas.

notes:
A compound of {優勝|ゆうしょう} (winning a championship) and {者|しゃ} (person). Used for competitions of all kinds — sports, academic contests, cooking competitions, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {優勝者|ゆうしょうしゃ}を{決|き}める: to determine the champion
- {優勝者|ゆうしょうしゃ}に{選|えら}ばれる: to be chosen as the winner
- {優勝者|ゆうしょうしゃ}を{表彰|ひょうしょう}する: to honor the champion
- {歴代|れきだい}{優勝者|ゆうしょうしゃ}: past champions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- チャンピオン: champion — the loanword, more casual and commonly used in boxing and professional sports
- {勝者|しょうしゃ}: winner — more general; the winner of any contest or match, not necessarily a championship
- {覇者|はしゃ}: champion, conqueror — more literary, implies dominance
